messages:
Priya S: Heads-up: partner asks for a hybrid POC covering EU + CN customers. Main asks: regional tenancy, streaming responses for chat, function-calling hooks, and a short free trial.
Hank M: Hybrid sounds like Private in CN + Hosted EU. Streaming + function-calls across regions is tricky due to latency and data plane separation.
Vera R: For function-calling we can surface webhooks from the CN tenant to partner infra only if they allow inbound webhooks. Otherwise we can proxy via a regional relay. Need partner network preferences.
Sam B: Also pricing: they want a per-session cap and waived egress the first month. BizOps will need expected sessions/day and avg token length.
Priya S: Partner estimating 2k active sessions/day, avg 300 tokens per session, with heavy streaming (many partials).
legal-nora: If data stays in-region, confirm whether Redwood staff need access. No access preferred requires contract clause and limited support model.
Vera R: Tech constraints: streaming requires persistent websocket connections to the tenant. For CN tenant we'll need to provision VPN/NAT and provide static IPs. infra-bot: Provision ticket created: T-4482, ETA 5 business days after creds.
Hank M: Latency note: cross-region relaying for function-calls will add ~120-250ms depending on path. We'll include a diagram.
Sam B: Action items: 1) Priya draft POC ask doc + traffic numbers. 2) Vera outline webhook/relay patterns and sample flow. 3) Hank produce latency table for fp16/int8 and streaming p95. 4) Nora draft limited-access clause for the contract. 5) I'll work with BizOps on a capped trial credit.
Priya S: I'll also ask partner if they accept limited read-only logs for debugging. If not, we flag as enterprise blocker.
Vera R: I'll add a `curl` + websocket snippet for the relay and a sample webhook auth header we recommend.
Hank M: Estimated p95 for 256 tokens on int8 on dedicated 40GB class w/ batching off: ~180ms; streaming adds ~50ms per chunk. Will include numbers.
legal-nora: If partner requires no Redwood personnel access, we need on-call escalation paths and a support ticket SLA. I'll draft the clause.
Sam B: BizOps note: propose trial credit 75k tokens + egress waiver up to 500GB for 30 days. I'll submit for approval.
Priya S: Can we target partner update Tuesday EOD? They want to present to execs Wed.
Vera R: I can have the relay docs + snippets Monday EOD.
Hank M: Latency table and instance recommendations Monday AM.
legal-nora: Draft clause Monday AM as well.
Sam B: I'll ping BizOps now and loop in pricing team.
Priya S: Thanks team — I'll schedule a 30-min sync Mon 9am SGT if that works for partner. :calendar:
